description: Eaux d'inondations détectées par satellite le 20 octobre 2024 dans les départements de Matam et Kanel, Sénégal is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20241022SEN Cette carte illustre l'étendue des eaux d'inondations détectées par satellite en utilisant une image optique Sentinel-2 acquise le 20 octobre 2024 dans les départements de Matam et Kanel, Région de Matam. Dans la zone analysée d'environ 2,700 km², un total d'environ 500 km² de terres semblent être inondées. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
